_: CORPUS DESCRIPTOR — declares the shape of a tree so the map tools can
read it without knowing anything about the domain. Copy this, edit the
globs and patterns to match your tree, and the map works on your
project. Nothing below mentions number theory, Lean, or any subject.
Declaring the shape IS the standardization. A tool that has to be
edited per project is not agnostic; a tool that reads a declaration is.
Every regex is Python `re`, matched multiline against the file with
fenced code blocks blanked. Capture groups are named in each section.
name: example

record._: The dated append-only log. Groups: 1=date 2=id 3=title. Optional volumes bound which ids may appear in which file.

code._: Source carrying named declarations. `pin_re` is optional — omit it and no pin flag is produced.

documents._: Sectioned prose. Each label becomes an addressable node.

collections._: A set of files that are nodes by path. require_keys applies to JSON only and raises a conformance flag when absent.

commits._: Commits become nodes only if git knows them — git is the gate. Set to false for a tree without git.

link_patterns._: The gated edge grammar. A link is emitted only when its target is already a node, so a pattern cannot invent one.
